title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling samples, and docs quickstarts
author: Asha Patel
description: Adds a set of reusable RAG templates and agent/tool-calling example quickstarts for Python and TypeScript, plus docs site quickstart pages. Motivation: make it easier for engineers to get started with retrieval-augmented generation and tool-calling agents using Redwood runtime and SDKs. This PR includes templates for common retrieval stacks (embedding + vector DB + retriever), agent examples demonstrating tool-calling patterns (search, browser, calendar, and external API calls), and docs updates with step-by-step quickstarts and snippets. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates (yaml) for FAQ, support-bot, and enterprise-search flows - [x] Add Python agent examples (tool-calling) and tests - [x] Add TypeScript examples and small README quickstarts - [x] Docs site quickstarts and sidebars updated - [x] Lint/format and CI fixes - [x] Minor runtime compatibility tweaks for tool call metadata Note: examples are intentionally small and use mock backends where external credentials would be required. This keeps quickstarts runnable in CI and on local machines with minimal setup. Related Linear: ENG-4201, DOC-311.

release_notes: Add RAG templates and agent tool-calling quickstarts: new examples and documentation for RAG workflows and tool-calling agents. Includes Python and TypeScript samples, CI-tested unit tests, and docs site quickstarts. Recommended upgrade: pin SDK >= 0.9.1 for callTool compatibility.
notes_for_reviewers: This PR is intentionally conservative: templates are commented and examples use mocked services to keep CI deterministic. If you'd like additional real-provider integrations (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate), we can add them as follow-up PRs behind feature flags.
summary: Developer quickstarts and examples for RAG templates and agent tool-calling added, with docs site updates and passing CI.
